name: InVideo
summary: Turns a prompt or script into a first-draft video with AI voiceover, templates and stock footage. Plans are priced per seat and metered in monthly credits that do not roll over.
best_for: marketing teams and creators who want to turn a prompt or script into a publish-ready first-draft video fast, using templates, AI voiceover and stock
skip_if: you need frame-level creative control, long-form or highly bespoke production, or your usage would blow past the monthly credit allowance
honest_knock: The honest catch is the credit model — each plan is a fixed monthly credit allowance that different models consume at different rates, and unused credits do not roll over, so a heavy month can exhaust an allowance long before it renews while a slow month simply wastes what you paid for. There is also no free way in any more: on 31 August 2026 the pricing page published no free tier at all, and on 24 September 2026 the cheapest route to trying it was Starter at $20 a seat a month, with 400 credits. AI video is fast but generic by default: templated output needs real editing and brand direction to not look like everyone else's. Treat it as a first-draft engine, not a finished-studio replacement.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per seat a month on either billing term (400 credits/seat/mo, up to 5 seats)
pricing.notes: Three plans priced per seat, re-verified on invideo.io/pricing on 24 September 2026; the page was rebuilt after 5 September, when it listed Plus, Max, Generative and Elite. Starter is $20 a seat a month on either billing (400 credits a seat a month, up to 5 seats), Plus $50 a seat annually or $60 monthly (2,000 credits, up to 10 seats) and Max $100 a seat annually or $150 monthly (5,000 credits, up to 20 seats; 10,000- and 15,000-credit sizes are offered but not priced in the served page). Storage is 200 GB, 600 GB and 2,000 GB; Seedance 2.5 and Seedance 2.0 at 4K start on Plus. Credits are the meter: AI generations draw them down, timeline editing and downloads do not, the allowance resets each billing cycle without rollover, and extra credit packs are sold separately. No free tier is published, although a cancelled plan drops to a Free plan.
